name: SmartBaroda
headline: SmartBaroda: AI Banking Content Generation
short_description: Project aims to solve the problem of personalized content generation for the banking sector, enhancing customer satisfaction and engagement through tailored content. Solution uses advanced AI to deliver personalized marketing materials, financial reports, and educational content.
author: kamalyash2002

sections.overview:
SmartBaroda generates personalized marketing materials, financial reports, and educational content for banking customers using advanced AI and machine learning. The system uses Azure Machine Learning, OpenAI's language models, and Langchain agents to analyze customer data and create tailored content in real-time. It distributes personalized content across multiple channels including email, SMS, and mobile apps, while continuously gathering feedback to refine personalization algorithms. The solution integrates Azure Data Factory for data ingestion, Azure Kubernetes Service for model deployment, and Power BI for analytics. Banks benefit from enhanced customer satisfaction and engagement through highly targeted, data-driven content strategies.
Generate personalized marketing campaigns based on customer financial profiles
Create tailored financial reports and educational materials for different customer segments
Deliver real-time personalized content recommendations via email, SMS, and mobile
Analyze customer data to improve content relevance and engagement metrics
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/kamalyash2002/SmartBaroda`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a marketing expert for [COMPANY], a bank in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Generate a personalized email campaign for [CUSTOMER_SEGMENT] based on their [DATA] such as transaction history, product usage, and preferences. Ensure the content is engaging, informative, and tailored to their financial goals.
```
Copy

```
# Personalized Email Campaign for Young Professionals

**Subject:** Boost Your Financial Growth with Our Exclusive Offer!

Dear [Customer Name],

We noticed you've been actively using our mobile banking app and have shown interest in investment products. As a young professional, we understand that growing your wealth is a top priority. That's why we've curated this exclusive offer just for you:

- **Investment Opportunities:** Explore our high-yield savings accounts and low-risk investment funds tailored for your financial goals.
- **Financial Planning Webinar:** Join our upcoming webinar on 'Building Wealth in Your 30s' to learn from our financial experts.
- **Personalized Financial Checkup:** Schedule a one-on-one session with our financial advisor to review your current portfolio and plan for the future.

**Call to Action:** Click here to learn more about our exclusive offers and take the first step towards achieving your financial dreams.

Best regards,
[Bank Name] Team
```
